content.text: VIII. Decorative Blocks
Click an item entry below to jump to it.

items.text: Copper, Silver, Gold and Ancient Coin Stacks

content.text: Decorative blocks furnish towns, camps, religious sites and graveyards. Most provide only appearance and collision; a few have lighting, container or coin-stacking interactions and should be used accordingly.
Tables, Seats and Thrones
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Tables, Chairs, Stools, Benches, Scissor Seats, tribal furniture and Thrones furnish interiors. Check facing and leave room for tall or multipart furniture.
Ordinary seats currently have no sit interaction. Thrones grant no ruling authority, and furniture does not automatically become an NPC worksite. Their main purpose is decoration.
Fire Pits and Braziers
Acquisition: Fire Pit, Log Fire Pit and Square Fire Pit use the crafting table with no research prerequisite. Other variants in this group do not share those direct recipes.
Fire Pits, Log Fire Pits, Square Fire Pits and flaming Braziers provide bright decorative light. Ember Braziers emit weaker light for camps and interiors.
These lit-looking blocks emit light according to their settings; there is no universal Flint and Steel ignition workflow to add. They are not fuel inputs for Stirling Generators or cooking machines.
Altar Cloths and Candles
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Short and Long Altar Cloths and Altar Candles decorate altars. Templates or item data may carry appearance information. Preserve the chosen style rather than treating every variant as identical.
Altar Candles provide light and cloths are mainly decorative. They do not research, cast spells, change faction relations or trigger NPC resurrection.
Altars and Golden Idol
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Altar Lecterns, Sun Altars and the Golden Idol suit religious or ceremonial scenes. Place them to match the building's facing and leave overhead space for tall idols.
They are not Research Stations or enchanting facilities. Names such as altar or idol do not imply sacrifice, summoning or buff systems.
Totems and Idol Components
Acquisition: Totem Base, Middle and Top use the crafting table with no research prerequisite. Other variants in this group do not share those direct recipes.
Orc and Goblin Totems have ordinary and lit variants. Multipart decorations include Totem Base, Middle, Top and Wings, plus Irminsul, Elephant Idol and Xoltec Idol components.
Assemble matching components for a complete decoration; completing the shape does not turn it into a machine. Lit and ordinary variants are separate entries, so read their names.
Gravestones
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Eight Gravestone styles decorate graveyards and ruins. Choose a shape and place it with the desired facing. They do not store player death items or record NPC resurrection tasks.
To resurrect allied NPCs, use the Town Hall and Priest system in Chapter V, not a Gravestone at the death position.
Coffins, Urn and Loot Basket
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Wooden and Stone Coffins, the Urn and Loot Basket are containers that can be opened to store real items. They combine decorative appearance with storage.

A loot-container appearance does not imply endlessly refreshing rewards. Handle contents before removing or moving them. They are not automatically Warehouse Storage; see Chapter IV for warehouse recognition.
Cages, Racks and Stakes
Acquisition note: this group currently has no direct finished-item recipe in the ordinary crafting table or Engineering Station. Do not assume it is directly craftable.
Iron Cages, Gibbet Cages, Wooden Posts, Racks and Stakes decorate prisons, camps and execution grounds. Some occupy multiple parts of space; leave room for the whole structure.
Their appearance does not provide a complete capture, imprisonment or interrogation system. Placing a cage near an NPC does not change its faction or behavior.
Copper, Silver, Gold and Ancient Coin Stacks
Acquisition: crafting table; no research prerequisite.

Coin Stacks let you place and recover the corresponding coins. Each level holds eight coins, from 8 to 64 per stack. Right-click with at least eight matching coins to add a level to a non-full stack, consuming eight.

Right-click with an empty hand or a non-matching item to recover eight coins; the stack disappears when its last eight are taken. Breaking also returns matching coins. Stacks do not generate money or convert between the four currencies.
